name: JW Marriott Houston by The Galleria
insider_take: Where luxury meets Houston's shopping capital – this Galleria gem puts you in the heart of the city's most dynamic district.
whats_special: Connected directly to The Galleria mall (Texas's largest shopping center with 400+ stores), this JW Marriott sits atop one of Houston's most prestigious retail destinations. The hotel's prime location offers skyline views of downtown Houston and easy access to the city's upscale Uptown district, known locally as the "second downtown."
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 20+ for stunning views of Houston's sprawling cityscape, and take advantage of the climate-controlled walkways to explore The Galleria without stepping outside in Houston's humid weather.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to Houston's Museum District (just 15 minutes away), home to 19 world-class museums including the Museum of Fine Arts and Space Center Houston. The Galleria area also features an ice skating rink – a refreshing surprise in this Texas heat – and some of Houston's finest dining along Westheimer Road.
pros: Prime location connected to The Galleria shopping mall
Luxurious rooms with premium amenities and city views
Exceptional service standards of JW Marriott brand
Full-service spa and state-of-the-art fitness facilities
cons: Busy shopping district location with heavy traffic
